method: Built-in imagegen. New transparent sprite artwork created from the user's B concept description; not copied from a concept contact sheet or procedurally drawn.
linen_prompt: NEW game sprite: a compact recessed fracture cavity decal in a mummy's linen-covered skull, to overlay INSIDE the right side of its head. NOT a detached piece of cloth. Shape is a blunt irregular rounded vertical oval, ratio 0.8 width to 1 height, no spikes and no pointed long ends. 70 percent of its visible area is a deep dark-brown shadow cavity, uneven and cracked inward. Very narrow rim of dry ivory chipped bone along left and lower edge, only two or three small irregular pale fragments. A THIN border of creamy beige linen around the cavity, short frayed fibers that stay almost flush to the edge. Minimal surrounding fabric; dark cavity dominant. Cavity is opaque dark warm brown, outside rim is true transparent alpha. Looks like a hollow concave bite or indented fracture in a wrapped head, not a leaf, ear, feather, grass stalk, strip, ribbon, flapping bandage, badge, eye socket, eye or full skull. Fine elegant warm painted cartoon illustration, dense subtle linen weave only on the thin rim, warm shadows, readable at 35x45 pixels. Do not draw a head or any other object. No bright red, blood, wet flesh, brains, gore, smoke, text, background, drop shadow or external floating fragments. Isolated sprite tightly framed with small transparent margin. Essential: short BLUNT top and bottom, large recessed dark cavity, tiny pale dry bone lip, absolutely no upward pointed cloth extension.
papyrus_edit_prompt: Make the PAPYRUS variant of this compact recessed mummy-head fracture cavity. Keep the identical blunt compact shape, dark-brown concave interior and chipped dry ivory bone at left/lower edge, with no long points. Change ONLY the thin outer cloth rim: replace beige grid-woven linen with golden-tan papyrus and fine longitudinal plant fibers. Dark cavity remains dominant, tiny bone lip remains pale ivory. Fine warm educational painted-cartoon game sprite, matching the same lighting and detail. Transparent background retained; no head, body, mask, text, arrows, gore, blood, red tissue, brain, wet flesh or detached fibers. Do not turn it into a feather, leaf, flap or ribbon. Single standalone cavity decal.
integration: Only head_notch (brain choice 2) instantiates the sprite. It fits uniformly into a 44x53 logical frame tied to fitted body coordinates. Separate linen/papyrus textures; water and beer use restrained tinting. The complete gold-mask sprite is drawn above it and moves down 14 logical units only for this variant to expose the wrapped cap. No scoring, content, audio, body texture or coffin changes.
runtime_budget: Import size_limit 256 with mipmaps; each imported texture is 204x256. Original 1122x1402 source pixels retained. Both compressed runtime textures together occupy 123384 bytes. Old hanging-strip asset remains on disk but is not used by the renderer.
quality: test_head_side_crack_quality.gd verifies original/imported dimensions and texture density against the torso at 1600x900, 1920x1080, 3840x2160 and 390x844. At Full HD, the crack displays at about 47.92x60.13 pixels (4.26 texture pixels per display pixel); at 4K, about 95.83x120.26 (2.13 texture pixels per display pixel). Native framebuffer screenshots and 1:1 head crops are saved without resizing or sharpening.
validation: test_head_side_crack.gd: all 243 combinations, 81 crack / 162 absent, 54 masked cases, rendered-pixel visibility, material identity, mask ordering, full quiz/reveal/detail/replay/home flow. test_clarity.gd: all 243 combinations, 1215 hotspot openings and 15 mappings. test_session.gd and test_ritual.gd retained. test_head_side_crack_quality.gd: 126 resolution, density, proportion and native-capture checks across 24 representative layouts.
limitations: Physical mobile devices and Web export not tested.
Head decay and opened skull are mutually exclusive brain answers; organ decay, wetness, hollow body and papyrus combinations remain covered.
